q1_issues.issue: The 'when' clause contributes no temporal relation at all — nothing orders or nests the moving and the dragging (no Before/During), so the sealed report loses the time link the sentence states.

'across the ground' is encoded as (Location sk_drag_1 sk_ground_1), but Location is specified for 'in/at/on'; a non-containment preposition is supposed to keep the surface word actually used as its head.

q2_gaps: simultaneity 'when'-clause ('When X was V-ed, Y V-ed'): the time section fixes canonical heads for after/before/during/while, but names none for plain 'when' outside the past-perfect (Before) case
path prepositions on an event ('across the ground'): the event-side oblique list gives Location for in/at/on and no explicit rule for a path PP that answers 'where' without stating containment
notes: Sealing the whole report under say's Theme (non-factive) while projecting every definite referent's typing at top level is handled correctly, as are the agentless passive, Goal for 'to the bus', and Theme for the displacement verbs. One split is left inconsistent: the definite NP 'his paralyzed body' projects (Member sk_body_1 body) but keeps its modifier (Member sk_body_1 paralyzed) inside the seal — the instruction set licenses projection only of the typing atom, so this is defensible but undecided.
